properties.description: Where an export's lineage is anchored: the record as COMMITTED, not the file on disk. Resolves the default branch (origin/HEAD first, then origin/main, origin/master, main, master), takes the merge-base with HEAD, and reads that path's blob at that commit. Every failure — no git on PATH, not a repository, no default branch, no merge-base, path not committed, the committed blob not an export — returns a NAMED reason rather than an error, and the caller falls back to on-disk chaining. reflow2's first use of git anywhere in either crate; it lives in the MCP crate so the core stays the pure graph library.
